name: Gateway National Golf Links
title: Gateway National Caddie
sub: NCCGA Regional 3, Nov 14-15 2026 · Driver 275/300 · 2-wood 265/280 · 4-wood 255/270 at 70°F · club and aim re-solved for the wind and temperature at each hole

climate.source: mid-November normals for St. Louis (lows ~38 F, highs ~57 F, prevailing SSW wind ~10 mph)

foot: Tee sets: Back (6,623, 72.4/133) is the set the NCCGA played here in 2024 (6,623; Nov 2025 used a 6,377 combo); Middle (6,154) is fully solved from its own boxes; The Tips, Champions and Forward move the Back tee along the line. The tee sheet is not posted: check each tee plaque and use Move this tee to match it (tee shots are solved every 20 yds; par 3s move in 5-yd steps). Calm-day picks: 256 prior draws per hole; the wind grids at the card tee are refined on 16,000 common swings per club. Clubs: Driver to Mid iron plus an 8-iron (162 carry, assumed ~12-yd gapping below the 210 long iron). A tee ball on or by a green is scored with putts (drivable 10). The map was checked on NAIP 2023 (0.3 m, colour infrared), NAIP 2022 and the 2014 3DEP lidar, and re-checked hole by hole on Nov 9. Photos: USDA NAIP 2023-08-19.

display_imagery.source: 2026-11-09: USDA NAIP 2023-08-19 0.30 m (il_m_3809023_se_15_030), the image the map was checked on. NAIP Plus (rev 1) served an older, shadowed mosaic here (different bunker / green shapes on 14; Laplacian sharpness 1.25-1.59 vs 1.60-2.23 for NAIP 2023)

page_text.source: golfer request 2026-11-06 (Eagle Knoll): no water / OB / hazard words or outlines on the page

condition_notes.10: Frozen or very firm ground (drives running 35+ yds): 4-wood, same line

18.Back: The Back markers may sit about 17 yds ahead of the card spot: check the plaque and use Move this tee

page_text.condition_source: 2026-11-13: Sat 24 F overnight, 35 F at 9:00. Central world with roll x1.25 / x1.5: 8 Driver holds (0.042 / 0.028), 9 Driver holds to a tie (0.020 / 0.007), 10 2-wood by 0.019 at x1.25 and 4-wood by 0.015 at x1.5, 16 4-wood holds

green_putting.source: Eagle Knoll panel finding 2026-11-06 (Broadie putts + 0.10 for a 5-handicap; short game below 20 yds); Gateway: the 271-yd 10th

engine.source: Gateway National 2026-11-09 (OPTIMIZE.md section 2): the Eagle Knoll engine options that apply. 8-iron = Will's 210 long iron with ~12-yd gapping (assumed, as Eagle Knoll); green putting (a tee ball on or by the green scores putts / short game: the drivable 10th). Flight-path trees NOT enabled: the lidar crowns along every Back tee shot change no pick and no margin by more than 0.0004 strokes, even with +6 m growth and k 0.25 (section 2c), and the 2014 Madison Co. HAG has 40-55 m spikes at the pond edges.
engine.aim_limit_source: audit 2026-11-09 item 6: hole 8 (dogleg left) had its best line on the default 40-yd bound; the stored prior-averaged curves show no other hole with a better aim past 40 (Back / Middle)
engine.checked_extra_source: 2026-11-13 second pass: hole 8 (dogleg left) leaves the +/-65-yd hand corridor at 240-345; the ground between the fairway's left edge and the cart path there (Back frame x -65..-128) was checked on NAIP 2023 + Sentinel-2 Nov 2026: mown rough. Without it the engine priced that rough as 'unverified' (half trees), which cost the Driver's line 0.05 strokes

physics.source: 2026-11-13 second pass, second_pass/PHYSICS.md (independent trajectory model fitted to the TrackMan tour tables): the engine's 0.00075 / F is the air alone; a ball at air temperature adds ~0.0004 / F (about 1 % of ball speed at 45 F) and the weekend's 1027-1031 hPa high another ~0.0002 / F equivalent between 38 and 52 F -> 0.00135; crosswind drift 1.5 yds per mph for every full shot (was 1.14 for the driver, 0.8 for a mid iron); head / tail multipliers for the shorter clubs (mid iron 1.65: -9 % of carry into 10 mph)

par3_targets_source: expected-strokes par-3 aim for an unknown pin on Will's iron pattern (PAR3.md, opt/par3_target.py, on the Nov 9 map); replaces the DECADE box on this page only
par3_bag_source: 70-F stock carries of the par-3 model (opt/par3_target.py bag; 4-iron = the engine's 210 long iron, 6-iron = the 185 mid iron; 5-, 7-, 9-iron, PW, GW, SW, LW assumed ~12-yd gapping)
par3_drift_source: second_pass/PHYSICS.md 2b: every full iron drifts 1.4-1.5 yds per crosswind mph (flight time 6.3-7 s); the page had no crosswind allowance on par 3s
temp_note: air, a ball at air temperature and this weekend's high pressure
